name: Acquire

categories.label: Cash on hand
categories.hint: Money held after mergers during play.

categories.label: Majority/minority bonuses at game end
categories.labelVi: Thưởng cổ đông lớn/nhỏ cuối game
categories.hint: Sum bonuses for all active chains per the stock price chart; ties split and rounded up to $100.

categories.label: Stock sold back to bank
categories.hint: Sell all shares at the price for each active chain's name and size; chains off board are worth 0.

tiebreakers.description: If tied for most money, victory is shared.

notes: family: money-economy. Scores are dollars, not VP. End: a player announces all active chains are safe or one chain has 41+ tiles. Verified on Renegade modern rulebook (Classic Mode); the 1963/Avalon Hill editions use the same end-game flow, but price chart values vary by edition, so bonuses/stock values are scorer inputs. Tycoon mode (tertiary bonus) not modelled.

sources.title: Acquire Rulebook (Renegade)
sources.section: The End of the Game, p.11-12; ties p.9
